input:
Labeled defect
- root cause: the per-chunk debug line logs chunks[0].score for every rank instead of chunk.score
- failure path: debug mode prints the same score for every retrieved chunk; whoever reads the log to tune the threshold sees ranks 2..k with the top score and draws the wrong conclusion

Reviewer finding
- description: The per-chunk debug log prints chunks[0].score for every rank instead of the current chunk's score, so the logged scores for ranks 2..N are wrong.
- rationale: Trigger: retrieval returns more than one chunk with differing scores and debug logging is enabled. Mechanism: the format arguments use chunks[0].score rather than chunk.score, so every line reports the top score. Impact: operators reading the logs to diagnose retrieval quality see misleading per-chunk scores; no user-facing output changes.
critique: The finding points to the same faulty operation as the label: the per-chunk debug log uses chunks[0].score where it should use chunk.score. It also describes the same consequence, with every rank showing the top score, which misleads anyone reading the logs.
